title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on eight Sparks
evidence_scope: The settings of the four-Spark profile deepseek-v41-flash-tp4 at tensor-parallel size 8 (DSpark5 with adaptive verification, Engram tables on disk, 16 sequences). Runs only on SIRCL ring sessions with NCCL off, on all eight Sparks of an eight-Spark ring; no image lock in this package lists it, so it installs only with a development image lock (v3) whose image carries the SIRCL layer and lists the profile. No installation of this profile has run on hardware; the four-Spark profile served on SIRCL at TP4 on a four-Spark line of an eight-Spark ring through SIRCL's launcher. Not serving-qualified.
